title: EHR_LINKAGE — Linked Records
description: Caliber endpoint items from linked health records: cancer registry, ONS mortality, hospital episodes and hospital out-patients.
$comment: Source note on the EHRData sheet: "Caliber endpoints will output as a dataset called 'Caliber' This dataset will also contain variable CenDate: Censor date for the combined sources of data;". CenDate was not requested (no X) and is not in this table (D086).

Caliber_CAN.title: Caliber Endpoints (Data Source: Cancer Registry)
Caliber_CAN.$comment: The dictionary (sheet EHRData, header 'Output Dataset') gives only a description naming the Caliber endpoint source: no Categories text, no type. Typed as text until the data provider says what the column holds (D086).
